Hi,

I succeeded to create a data.table in the output, containing a hyperlink for the column names.
However in the search field at the bottom this does not show up neatly, is there a way to change how the search fields are named?
Thanks.


Info <- renderDataTable({
  df <- data.frame(V1="field")
  colnames(df) = c('<a target=\"_blank\" href=http://url>species</a>')
  df
})

dataTableOutput("Info")
